#| label:  setup

library(factoextra)
library(corrplot)
library(ape)
source('https://inkaverse.com/setup.r')

# Research Objective

> https://docs.google.com/spreadsheets/d/1Us3b4buA-tXxltZd1kd970NttFA4k_apQvLdQ8BXXTw/edit?gid=543463494#gid=543463494

# Data import

- Data morfológica curada de los maíces amiláceos Peruanos de Grobman et al (1961). 

- Select variables with more than 80% of data.

```{r}
url <- "https://docs.google.com/spreadsheets/d/1Us3b4buA-tXxltZd1kd970NttFA4k_apQvLdQ8BXXTw/edit?gid=37859623#gid=37859623"

gs <- url %>% 
  as_sheets_id()

rawdata <- gs %>% 
  range_read("STable1")
rawdata %>% dim()
rawdata %>% str()

fb <- rawdata %>% 
  dplyr::select(where(~ mean(!is.na(.x)) >= 0.8)) %>% 
  rename_with(~ tolower(gsub(" ", "_", .x))) %>% 
  rename_with(~ tolower(gsub("\\(|\\)", "", .x))) %>% 
  mutate(across(1:plant_pubescence, ~ as.character(.))) %>% 
  mutate(across(1:plant_pubescence, ~ as.factor(.))) 
fb %>% dim()

cat("Variables with more 80% of data: ", ncol(fb))

fb %>% str()

web_table(fb, caption = "Data with variables with more than 80% data")
```

# Summary data

```{r}
smr <- fb %>% 
  summarise(across(where(is.numeric), list(mean = ~ mean(x = ., na.rm = T)
                                           , sd = ~ sd(x = ., na.rm = T)
                                           , min = ~ min(x = ., na.rm = T)
                                           , max = ~ max(x = ., na.rm = T)
                                           , var  = ~ var(x = ., na.rm = T)
                                           ))) %>% 
  rowid_to_column() %>% 
  pivot_longer(!rowid) %>% 
  separate(name, c("trait", "stat"), sep = "_(?=[^_]+$)") %>% 
  pivot_wider(names_from = stat, values_from = value) %>% 
  dplyr::select(!c(rowid))
  
smr %>% kable()

# smr |> write_sheet(ss = gs, sheet = "STable2")
```

# RO 1

```{r}
dtx <- fb

# str(dtx)
  
mv <- dtx %>% 
  column_to_rownames("race") %>% 
  mutate(across(1:4, ~ as.factor(.))) %>% 
  PCA(X = ., scale.unit = T, graph = F, quali.sup = c(1:5), ncp = 10)

pcainfo <- factoextra::get_pca(mv); pcainfo

pcainfo$contrib %>% kable(caption = "Variable Contribution")
pcainfo$cos2 %>% kable(caption = "Variable Cos2")
pcainfo$cor %>% kable(caption = "Variable correlations")

p1 <- fviz_eig(mv, 
                addlabels=TRUE,
                hjust = 0.05,
                barfill="white",
                barcolor ="darkblue",
                linecolor ="red") + 
  ylim(0, 30) +
  labs(
    title = "PCA - percentage of explained variances",
    y = "Variance (%)") +
  theme_minimal()

p1

p2 <- fviz_contrib(mv,
                     choice = "var", 
                     axes = 1, 
                     top = 30,
                     fill="white",
                     color ="darkblue"
                   , sort.val = "asc"
                   ) +
  ylim(0, 8) +
  labs(title = "Dim 1 - variables contribution", x = "") +
  coord_flip()

p2

p3 <- fviz_contrib(mv,
                     choice = "var", 
                     axes = 2, 
                     top = 30,
                     fill="white",
                     color ="darkblue"
                   , sort.val = "asc"
                   ) +
  ylim(0, 8) +
  labs(title = "Dim 2 - variables contribution", x = "") +
  coord_flip()

p3

panel_a <- c(p1, p2, p3) %>% 
  plot_grid(plotlist = ., ncol = 1, labels = "auto", rel_heights = c(1, 1.2, 1.2))
  
p4 <- \() {
  
pcainfo$cos2[, 1:2] %>% 
  corrplot(
    is.corr = F
    , method = "number",
    type = "full",
    tl.col = "black",
    tl.srt = 45,
    tl.cex = 0.6, 
    number.cex = 0.5, 
    number.digits = 1,
    cl.cex = 0.7,
    cl.pos = "r",
    cl.align = "r",
    cl.ratio = 4 
  )

}

grid <- c(panel_a, p4) %>% 
  plot_grid(plotlist = ., ncol = 2, labels = c("", "d"))

plot <- grid %>% 
  ggsave(plot = ., "manuscript/Figure-1.jpg"
         , units = "cm"
         , width = 28, height = 40)

plot %>% include_graphics()
```

# Descriptors with most to phenotypic differentiation

```{r}
# ============================================================
# 1. Datos de PCA
# ============================================================

contrib <- pcainfo$contrib %>%
  as.data.frame() %>%
  rownames_to_column("variable")

cos2 <- pcainfo$cos2 %>%
  as.data.frame() %>%
  rownames_to_column("variable")

# ============================================================
# 2. Selección inicial de variables
# ============================================================

n_traits <- 68

expected_contrib <- 100 / n_traits

contrib_selected <- contrib %>%
  dplyr::select(variable, Dim.1, Dim.2) %>% 
  pivot_longer(!c(variable)) %>% 
  dplyr::filter(value > expected_contrib) %>% 
  rename(contribution = value)
    
cos_selected <- cos2 %>%
  dplyr::select(variable, Dim.1, Dim.2) %>% 
  pivot_longer(!c(variable)) %>% 
  dplyr::filter(value > 0.6) %>% 
  rename(cos2 = value)
    
selection_table <- merge(contrib_selected, cos_selected) 
  

selection_table %>% kable()

selected_traits <- selection_table %>% 
  pluck(1) %>% 
  unique()

traits <- range_read(gs, "STable2x")

table2 <- merge(selection_table, traits) %>% 
  dplyr::select(Trait, variable, Unit:Max, everything()) 

# table2 %>% range_write(gs, .,  "Table2")
```

## RO 2

```{r}
dtsl <- fb %>% 
  dplyr::select(race, group, {{selected_traits}})

mv <- dtsl %>% 
  column_to_rownames("race") %>% 
  mutate(across(group, ~ as.factor(.))) %>% 
  PCA(X = ., scale.unit = T, graph = F, quali.sup = c(1))

pcainfo <- factoextra::get_pca(mv); pcainfo

pcainfo$cor %>% kable(caption = "Variable correlations")
pcainfo$contrib %>% kable(caption = "Variable Contribution")
pcainfo$cos2 %>% kable(caption = "Variable Cos2")

var <- fviz_pca_var(mv
                    , repel = TRUE
                    , labelsize = 3
                    )

var

ind <- plot.PCA(mv, choix = c("ind")
                , cex = 0.8
                , label = "ind"
                , invisible = "quali"
                , habillage = 1
                )  +
  theme(
    legend.position = "bottom",       # leyenda abajo
    legend.direction = "horizontal"   # en una sola línea
  ) + guides(color = guide_legend(nrow = 1))

ind

cls <- HCPC(mv, graph = F, nb.clust = -1)

cls$call$t$tree
cls$data.clust # Cluster membership of each individual
cls$desc.var$quanti # Quantitative variables characterizing each cluster
cls$desc.var$category # Categorical variables significantly by cluster 
table(cls$data.clust$clust) # Number of individuals assigned to each cluster

clsp <- function() {
  
  plot.HCPC(cls, choice = "map", draw.tree = F)
  
}

grid <- plot_grid(plotlist = list(var, clsp)
                  , ncol = 2, labels = "auto")

grid

plot <- grid %>% 
  ggsave(plot = ., "manuscript/Figure-2.jpg", units = "cm"
                , width = 40, height = 20)

plot %>% include_graphics()
```

## RO 3

Comparar con la clasificación de Grobman et al. 1961 (Table 8, Pag. 139):

Grobman, Alexander; Wilfredo Salhuana, Ricardo Sevilla y Paul C. Mangelsdorf. 1961. Races of Maize in Peru: Their Origins, Evolution and Classification.
(Publication 915). Washington, D.C.: National Academy of Sciences,
National Research Council.

```{r}
ind <- plot.PCA(mv
                , choix = c("ind")
                , cex = 0.8
                , label = "ind"
                , invisible = "quali"
                , habillage = 1
                )  +
  theme(
    legend.position = "bottom",       
    legend.direction = "horizontal"  
  ) + guides(color = guide_legend(nrow = 1))

ind

hc <- cls$call$t$tree
k <- length(unique(cls$data.clust$clust)) 
clus <- cutree(hc, k)

colors <- c("salmon", "black", "forestgreen", "orange", "blue", "brown")

clsp_fan <- function() {
  
  plot(as.phylo(hc)
     , type = "fan"
     , tip.color = colors[clus]
     , label.offset = 0.01
     , cex = 0.5)
  
}

clsp <- \() {
  
  plot.HCPC(cls, choice = "map", draw.tree = F) # tree?
  
}

plot <- c(ind, clsp_fan) %>% 
  plot_grid(plotlist = ., nrow = 1, labels = "auto"
            , rel_widths = c(1, 1.2)) %>% 
  ggsave2("manuscript/Figure-3.jpg"
          , plot = .
          , width =40 , height = 20
          , units = "cm")

plot %>% include_graphics()
```
